reuse.why: Extends the existing shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory predicate and getBudgetData query that all month-wide actions already use, and drops setZero's group_hidden: 0 workaround.

duplication.why: The rule itself lives once, but the same categories-join-groups SELECT is edited in three average actions and copied into setZero, a fourth copy of the query instead of one shared month-category fetch.

placement.why: The skip rule stays in the shared predicate in budget/actions.ts next to the month-wide actions that use it.

scope.why: Limited to the predicate, the queries that feed it and one test.

maintainability.why: The rule is centralised, but the predicate's action parameter is now unused and the category query is still repeated in four places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) go through shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: The setZero query is a plain copy of the average actions' categories/category_groups join, not disguised.

one_place.where: shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory in budget/actions.ts decides hidden, group-hidden and template-managed skipping for every month-wide action; the queries only supply the columns.
